tools.name: master_song
tools.description: Opens the Bandmixr studio in the chat to master or enhance a finished song (a stereo mix). The song is checked in the browser for loudness, peaks, stereo image and tonal balance, and a 30-second mastered preview plays next to the original. Mastering the full song needs a Bandmixr account.

tools.name: check_mix
tools.description: Opens the Bandmixr Mix Analyzer in the chat. It checks a mix or master in the browser (the file is not uploaded): loudness (LUFS), true peak, clipping, stereo image and tonal balance, with a verdict for each and a 30-second mastered preview.

tools.name: get_analyzer_session
tools.description: Returns a 30-minute ticket and the address of the Bandmixr preview service, which the studio in the chat uses for the 30-second mastered preview. The studio calls this tool on its own; the assistant does not need to call it directly.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Shows the connected Bandmixr account's plan and its limits (stems per song, song length, storage) and whether it can master to a reference track. Needs the person to connect their Bandmixr account.

tools.name: list_songs
tools.description: Lists the person's Bandmixr songs, most recently changed first.

tools.name: get_song_status
tools.description: One song's stems with their labels and mix settings (canMove and canWiden say whether the mixer can move or widen a stem; null when not known), uploads and analysis still running, whether the person has confirmed the labels, the song's tempo, and where the mix and master stand.

tools.name: create_song
tools.description: Creates a new song in Bandmixr for mixing stems and opens the studio with its upload box. The genre is the one the person names (other when they name none). Mixing and mastering are part of it: they start by themselves once the stems are uploaded and the person has confirmed the labels in the studio

tools.name: update_song
tools.description: Changes the title, the genre (not while the song is being mixed) or the tempo of a song. get_song_status shows the tempo and whether Bandmixr detected it.

tools.name: open_song_studio
tools.description: Opens the Bandmixr studio for a song in the chat. It shows what the song needs next: the upload box for stems, the label check (only the person can confirm labels there), the mix progress, or the player with the original, the mix and the master.

tools.name: get_song_session
tools.description: Returns a 15-minute ticket for one of the person's songs, which the studio in the chat uses to upload stems, show the label check and the progress, and play the original, the mix and the master. The studio calls this tool on its own; the assistant does not need to call it directly.

tools.name: prepare_full_master
tools.description: Creates a new song named after the file the person checked in the studio and returns a short-lived ticket for uploading it, so the studio can upload and master the full song. The studio calls this tool when the person chooses to master the full song; the assistant does not need to call it directly.

tools.name: set_stem_labels
tools.description: Sets what is on each stem from what the person says about their files (stem ids and file names come from get_song_status). It does not confirm the labels: the person still confirms them with "Labels are correct" in the studio before anything is mixed.

tools.name: mix_and_master
tools.description: Mixes an existing song's stems and masters the mix in one go, for example to mix it again after its genre or labels changed; a song made with create_song is already set up for this. It waits for the uploads, the analysis and the person's "Labels are correct" in the studio, then starts by itself. Mix

tools.name: start_mastering
tools.description: Masters the song's finished mix: a mix made without a master, an uploaded mix, or again after the genre of an uploaded song changed. The song needs a finished mix, from mix_and_master or an uploaded mix. The studio shows the progress and plays the new master, which replaces an earlier master made in

tools.name: adjust_mix
tools.description: Changes a song mixed from stems the way the person asks after listening. Per stem: volume, mute, position (left to right), reverb (space), stereo width, tone (brightness, body, mids, low cut, air, high cut), punch, drive (warmth or crunch), chorus, phaser, flanger, tremolo and echo. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_mix, get_analyzer_session, open_song_studio, get_song_session, start_mastering · Private data: check_mix, prepare_full_master, set_stem_labels, start_mastering, adjust_mix · Public sink: create_song, open_song_studio, get_song_session, prepare_full_master.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_mix, get_analyzer_session, open_song_studio, get_song_session, start_mastering · Private data: check_mix, prepare_full_master, set_stem_labels, start_mastering, adjust_mix · Public sink: create_song, open_song_studio, get_song_session, prepare_full_master

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_account" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
